name: Latifa Zala
source:
Latifa Zala is now the fully brainwashed sex slave of Dario Dalisso.

Note that she does not show up in the game. Her character sprite only appears in the end credits of the game.

The game confirms that Latifa Zala's new corrupted lewd form has received some pushback from other Alliance female officers. Thus, she has been transferred from active duty to the Alliance's PR department. 

This is likely partially due to her breast's now constantly lactating. This change, along with her tanned skin, breast expansion and added promiscuity, were part of her sexual corruption and brainwashing done to her by Dario Dalisso. Her sexual corruption was completed back in the Isis game.

Dario Dalisso is likely ok with Latifa being transferred to Alliance PR. This is because he wants to keep his sex slaves safe as he put a bunch of effort into corrupting the females in the Isis game. 

He can also likely leverage Latifa's new PR position to his advantage for his future endeavours.
